name: workout-tracker
description: Personal workout tracker — web app + Capacitor iOS shell for native HealthKit access

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html app.js styles.css firebase-sync.js capacitor-health.js manifest.json service-worker.js icon-180.png icon-192.png icon-512.png www/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
